name: Prompt Suite Factory 🏭
description_md:
## What You Get

- One master prompt that builds a full cross-modal AI prompt suite on /initialize.

- Exact folder scaffold (ai-prompt-suite/…) with README + implementation docs.

- 
40+ assets generated: text, image, video, voice agents, and custom agent configs.

- Built-in platform picking (GPT-5, Claude 4, Nano Banana, GPT-4o, Sora/Veo3, etc.) with cost/latency notes.

- Compliance, ROI, and hallucination-mitigation baked in.

- Drop-in Business Context Template to tailor everything instantly.

- Deliverable: prompt text only (paste into Claude Code/Cursor).

- Want batch builders & scoring dashboards? Join Early AI-dopters: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
